switcher.switchFailed: The switch did not happen; you are still in {{name}}.

deleted.title: This space was deleted
deleted.body: The space you were working in was deleted in another session. Continue in the default space.

level.space: These settings apply only in {{space}}, and only to you. Your profile, appearance and model choices live in the instance area, behind the gear icon.

settings.title: Space settings
settings.heading: This space
settings.explainer: A space is a sealed partition: nothing in it is ever compared with, retrieved into, or reported beside another space.
settings.dangerExplainer: Deleting a space erases everything inside it, for every user, through the ordinary deletion saga: one signed receipt per source.
settings.defaultUndeletable: The default space cannot be deleted. It is where anything that names no space arrives.
settings.planEmpty: The space holds nothing yet; only the space itself will be removed.
settings.planReceipts: Every source is erased through the ordinary deletion saga with one signed receipt each, shared material included. The receipts remain verifiable after the space is gone.
settings.planFailed: The deletion plan could not be loaded.

firstRun.title: {{space}} is a new space, sealed and empty
firstRun.body: Everything captured here stays here: memory, sources, findings and reports in this space never mix with any other. Start a conversation or add the first documents.
